text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What she felt as she ran was the sensation 
of her past self falling apart. However, 
through running alongside her rivals—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shattering her fragile former self with 
her own hands, she became a brand-new 
Sakura Chiyono O and seized a way of 
running that wasn't of the past, but of 
the "now."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As someone who claimed first place, and as 
someone who surpassed her. Maruzensky 
congratulates her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two headed toward the promised 
Japan Cup as rivals.
